snippet.title: Diablo IV | Diablo 30th Anniversary Spotlight
snippet.description:
The Sanctuary you know is getting updates like you’ve never seen before.

Hear from Game Director Brent Gibson and Associate Game Director Zaven Haroutunian about the newest Lord of Hatred updates, and join the team in March for a deep dive into the Warlock class.
